popCulture.title: Metamorphoses
popCulture.creator: Ovid
popCulture.description: Book IX: Byblis' letter to her twin Caunus, the flight across Asia, and the spring born of her tears — Ovid's fullest incest metamorphosis.

popCulture.title: Byblis
popCulture.description: Miletus' daughter who loved her brother Caunus and dissolved into a spring — the Carian aetiology that keeps both twins in reception.

popCulture.title: Parthenius of Nicaea
popCulture.creator: Parthenius
popCulture.description: Love Romances §11 preserves alternate Byblis endings — hanging, pursuit, and the spring — the Hellenistic dossier behind Ovid's version.
